reviews.text: 意外的好玩，简直是类幸存者里面的一股泥石流，这个类型本来是在做减法，但这游戏居然做加法，而且不是加在游戏体量上，而是操作复杂度和玩法上。 说着游戏算一个新游戏类型都行，非常创新。 音乐也做的特别好，很有节奏。 想学周伯通的左手画圆右手画方吗，请务必从这个游戏开始。
有趣
非典型类吸血鬼幸存者游戏 极好的画风 极好的流畅度 极好的游戏体验 非常非常适合双人同屏玩 极度推荐！
好玩 一个问题是内容略显不足 第二个问题全成就有一个成就要死100次 困难无尽模式还挺有爽的能到20来分钟 另外我认为光圈是神技无论任何情况我都会选的技能
1个人玩满头大汗，2个人玩嬉皮笑脸。 可惜只有3关。机翻。 boss设计还不错，bgm和技能节奏卡点。 稳定强势的技能搭配其实就那几个，看似丰富其实不好用的都不爱选。 总之是值得体验的。
差不多4个半小时，剧情模式全部通过 非常非常有意思、与众不同的生存者游戏 刚上手觉得很难，打破常规玩法的难度 1个小时后就觉得很有意思 最后分享一下，打第三关boss 一定要选合体技，打boss的时候用 还有选战车，我这手残党靠近不了一点boss，全靠战车远程打伤害。不要选太多近战技能，没啥用，雷霆火花，非常有用的
非常与众不同的类幸存者游戏，需要同时操纵两个角色进行战斗，如此独特的系统下，武器设计也是非常有创意，推荐大家至少玩一下DEMO试试看！ 但是，目前游戏只有三关，而且已经不是EA阶段了，确实太短了，内容量非常不足！

非常好玩的类吸血鬼游戏（推荐用手柄玩） 优点： 1.一人操控两人游玩的形式非常新颖，且没想象中的那么难上手，和技能之间的联动做得很不错（也支持两个人玩）； 2.值得一提的是音效做得很好，打击声做得很有节奏感，完美融入了BGM中，每一局游戏玩到后面不会感到嘈杂，像是在指挥一场交响乐 3.视角转换很舒服不会觉得突兀 缺点： 1.整体内容是机翻的（比如damage翻译成损伤而非伤害加成等等），部分翻译未完全，不过不怎么影响游戏体验； 2.技能有点单调，期待后续能够有技能融合、附魔等玩法 3.流程太短，只有三个地图
双人成行？不，单人硬行~蛮不错的设计，就是boss战基本没法使用双人能力，得靠另外比如雷霆这种去打伤害。
Wow. Really sad I slept on this game for so long, it's incredible. Whoever programmed the weapons to match the tempo of the music and add to it, pat yourself on the back, because IT'S GREAT!

Good game! The graphic and sound design work together perfectly to make it feel INTENSE. Never played a game with this control scheme before, but it starts to makes sense after a while (enough for me to feel successful beating normal, not enough for me to want to try hard mode).

What a great little game, it has me not wanting to put it down. The stick of playing both guys at the same time is genius and very well done. Takes a min to get used to it but when you do man its rewarding. Cheers guys.

Takes a few runs to get used to controlling two characters, but it feels awesome once you get the hang of it. Only complaint I have is that it feels a bit grindy if you're struggling (hard mode on the demo) and when you've completed all the maps and just want to unlock everything.

Very unique survivor-like game. Mostly because you always control 2 characters at once. It takes quite a few hours for your brains to get used to the controls and how your skills behave. Camera can get in your way in some situations and if there are a lot of enemy ground attacks around your characters - you'll take unnecessary damage because of this. It's not a game for everyone. You'll either like or dislike the gameplay with passion. Definitely better with a controller. Can't recommend playing it with mouse and keyboard.

This game really suprised me. Im not even sure how i got it, i just found it in my library and gave it a chance. And damn! Playing two characters at once in such a game is a mechanic ive never played before and it works REALLY well. You have to dodge wich both characters simultaneously meanwhile the attacks and items are mostly passive and hit in the middle of the two in different patterns. There are some actively aimed options too but they tend to overwhelm me. With just a endless mode idk if the game could hold my attention, but luckily there is a small "story" with 3 levels and bosses to play before you dive into endless mode. This is a rouge light and you're max level after ~6h so this is not a very long game. Runs rock solid 40fps on the steamdeck.

This game says playing on a controller is recommended, and by god are they right. Because of this unique movement mechanics for single player runs, you will be controlling two characters at the same time. This design allows for some incredibly unique gameplay and a really challenging experience I was not ready for. Truthfully, after my first 2-3 attempts I thought I was not ever going to be able to beat the game, but the controls become familiar over time, and the power creep hits like a truck. It is rewarding and refreshing. Highly recommend the game to any rouge-like enthusiast out there.
Really great coop game. It feels like game was designed for coop from the very beginning.

This game gave me claustrophobia, entomophobia and made me cross-eyed just from the first stage itself. For some unknown reason I have also developed the habit of making both Archons move in the same direction from muscle reflex only to watch them die walking into the same pool of bug goo... then cuss profusely... for the past 20times. I hate myself but I also enjoy pain. I definitely recommend this.

1.远程同屏双人体验差。联机质量差是一方面，还有为什么要把角色的碰撞模型做出来？本来是双人合作通关的游戏，因为碰撞模型的存在，两个人必须远离对方，否则就会撞上，而且还会卡住一两秒，然后被怪蹭血。 2.难度成就不覆盖。困难难度跟简单难度还得打两个周目。

[h1] 优秀的游戏体验，糟糕的全成就体验 [/h1] 游戏本身很惊艳，左右手各控制一个角色的吸血鬼like，并且所有技能都踩在音乐的节拍上，打击感非常爽。 游戏只有3关，外加2个无尽关卡，内容量较少。 游戏的肉鸽部分，技能都能玩，没有那种一眼污染卡池的充数技能，当然了也分好用的技能和不大好用的技能。 如果你只是为了体验游戏，或者以通关为目的，那么恭喜你，你将会拥有5~8小时的愉快经历。为这让人眼前一亮的操作方式和激动人心的鼓点而喝彩。 但如果你想全成就，那么你将付出额外10小时的重复操作以及并不愉快的游戏体验。因为游戏全成就里需要困难模式通关以及联机模式通关。 简单模式通关后解锁困难模式，请务必开新档，切忌使用原存档会直接覆盖。 简单模式通关后解锁困难模式，请务必开新档，切忌使用原存档会直接覆盖。 简单模式通关后解锁困难模式，请务必开新档，切忌使用原存档会直接覆盖。 重要的事情说三遍。 等于全成就你得把游戏重新玩三遍，且并不会得到什么额外的体验，这就有些为难玩家了。并且如果你在通关了简单模式后，按照游戏内的指引开始困难模式并选了你之前的那个存档，那么恭喜你，你的存档将被覆盖掉。这也是评论区大部分人差评的原因。 如果看到这里你还是想要全成就。那么我将为您奉上我写的指南，如果您能不吝看完，或许能帮您节约3~5小时的时间。 当然您也可以在全成就的过程中任意时间点与自己和解，去他娘的全成就。 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3585378018 由于这个游戏实在太小众了，以至于指南里一份都没有，所以我只好自己写了，希望能对您有所帮助。 [h2] 最后祝您玩的开心！ [/h2]

作为一款小体量的类幸存者肉鸽，非常好玩但很受苦很难，手残和反应不够快的建议好好考虑一下再入手，一个人要控制两个角色移动躲避攻击还是相当有难度的，怪物的设计挺巧妙的，能看的出制作组在双人移动和怪物攻击方式上结合的很好。 目前感觉游戏内容不多，打完第二关就告诉我要面对最终关卡了，目测只有3关的样子，还有个无尽模式，玩了两个半小时，局外养成已经点了7成了，3个半小时通关了，确实体量还是挺小的，游戏底子是非常好的，希望制作组能继续补充更多内容。 机翻中文得扣分。 _____________________ tmd通关了以后选困难模式，选择存档以为是选存档继承，没想到变成了直接覆盖，困难模式直接从头来，老子辛辛苦苦解锁的东西都没了，有点病吧？
玩法音乐都还不错，就是难度有点太高点，成长提升也不大，反复试验没什么进展很消磨意志。

Archons, developed and published by BulletHell Studios, is an inventive entry in the bullet-hell genre that challenges players with fast-paced, strategic combat and a unique dual-character mechanic. Released in late 2024, the game has quickly gained attention for its originality, receiving overwhelmingly positive feedback for the way it reinvents the classic bullet-hell formula. Unlike traditional shooters, Archons demands players to think tactically and multitask, providing a fresh and engaging experience for both veteran and casual players. The core gameplay revolves around controlling two characters simultaneously, each with distinct abilities and playstyles. Players must coordinate both Archons, managing attacks, dodges, and positioning in real time, which adds a significant layer of complexity to the typical bullet-hell experience. This dual-character system encourages strategic thinking and quick reflexes, as players must anticipate threats and optimize their actions across two characters at once. While this mechanic introduces a steep learning curve, it also delivers a sense of accomplishment and depth once mastered, making combat encounters intensely satisfying. Progression in Archons is both meaningful and customizable. Players collect essence to upgrade their weapons and unlock new abilities, allowing for a wide range of combat strategies. The game also introduces bloodrunes, a risk-reward mechanic that lets players trade health for temporary but powerful boosts, further emphasizing tactical decision-making. This combination of upgrades and resource management ensures that no two playthroughs feel exactly the same, and it allows players to tailor their approach to suit their preferred playstyle, whether focusing on offense, defense, or balanced strategies. The game offers a variety of modes to keep the experience dynamic. Beyond the main campaign, Archons includes an endless mode, where procedurally generated levels challenge players to survive against relentless waves of enemies and bosses. Local co-op is another highlight, allowing two players to tackle the challenges together, creating opportunities for coordinated strategies and shared triumphs. These modes significantly enhance replayability, providing both solo and cooperative experiences that remain engaging over multiple sessions. Visually, Archons impresses with a vibrant and energetic art style. Levels are distinct and detailed, with environments that provide both aesthetic appeal and gameplay challenges. The Archons themselves are visually striking, with abilities and animations that evolve as players progress. Bullet patterns, explosions, and other visual effects are not only spectacular but also serve as critical gameplay indicators, ensuring that the fast-paced action remains readable even amidst chaos. The cohesive art direction complements the gameplay, making every encounter visually stimulating and engaging. Audio design further elevates the experience. Olivier Orand’s soundtrack enhances the tension and excitement of combat, with dynamic tracks that shift alongside gameplay intensity. Sound effects are crisp and impactful, providing satisfying feedback for both offensive and defensive actions. The combination of music and sound effects deepens immersion and adds to the thrill of narrowly dodging bullets or executing a perfectly timed attack. In summary, Archons is a bold and refreshing take on the bullet-hell genre. Its dual-character control system, customizable progression, and varied game modes offer a unique challenge that rewards strategic thinking and skillful execution. While the learning curve may initially challenge some players, mastering its mechanics provides a deeply satisfying and exhilarating experience. With its striking visuals, dynamic audio, and innovative gameplay, Archons stands out as a must-play title for fans of fast-paced action and tactical bullet-hell adventures. Rating: 8/10

Solid take within the respected genre. The game offers a unique approach with its duel-stick play-style. I've played solo and co-op. Both are fun and provide enough differences in terms of level of difficulty and default attack ability chosen. Some default attacks are more challenging to use during co-op vs solo. Games within this genre are typically easy to grasp, and this game is no different. That's a good thing as this game offers fluidity in game play and its UI. Because of this, new players should be able to understand the games concept/controls easily. The games visuals and sound design are pleasing. The music tends to go along with what's happening during play matching the current intensity. This can aid in drawing the player in the game allowing for a fun experience. This was all the case for me and my wife. Our runs were simply fun. I am interested in what's to come in this games future. If I had to criticize one thing about the game, it would be its in game sound FX in regards to each creature when they attack and die. I would include the characters vocals during play as well, to match the games intensity for a greater experience. Would love to hear the characters speak or yell during key moments or when an ultimate is activated. Currently the music carries the game play in this regard.
